QuestInfo.name: [Fox Valley] Footrace to Fox Valley
QuestInfo.0: #b#p3002020##k is so excited to finally have a recruit for the Fox Point Rangers! Now that you've joined up, it would be a great opportunity to talk to him in #b#m410000100##k and learn more.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3002020##k is ready to give you your first mission and speeds off in the blink of an eye! You'd better catch up to him in #b#m410000110##k if you're going to find out what he needs.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p3002020##k, leader of the Fox Point Rangers, said he's already got a mission for you and took off like a shot! You only just managed to catch up to him in #b#m410000110##k.

0.msg: Wow, he's quick! Better follow him fast!
